title: Directs the Oregon Public Defense Commission to study best practices to improve the provision of public defense services within this state, and provide the results of the study to the appropriate interim committees of the Legislative Assembly no later than December 31, 2026.
headline: SB 552 did not pass

claims.text: SB 552 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
